name: can_t_infer_from_this_type_on_static_cla_42530c3c
subject: fix(50952): Can't infer from this type on static class method call in JS Doc (#51149)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: In JS files, a @this JSDoc tag on a static class method or constructor was ignored, so `this` could not be inferred. The fix creates the this parameter from the JSDoc this tag type.
